notes.title: BUMBI Demo Update 1.5.1.0 - Bugs Squashed!
notes.notes:
🐶 Bumbi Patch Notes 🐾
Thanks for all the feedback on the demo! We've rolled out some much-needed fixes and updates—here’s what’s new in this build:



🎮 Gameplay Tweaks & Fixes:

🐾 Small collider adjustments to improve movement precision!

🧱 Fixed getting stuck on Level 6 near the end (had the wrong collider whoops).

🪂 Coyote time added for wall jumps, giving you that forgiving mid-air wiggle room (you're welcome).

🎮 Controller joystick down now lets you slide.

🧊 Pressing down while wall sliding now slides you faster down the wall. It isn't super noticeable, wondering if I should make this faster? 👀

🐞 Bug Fixes:

🔄 Fixed input device switching during menu navigation.

💾 Settings and save scores now work properly.

🦴 Bones collected during the level now actually show up (important for bone hoarders).

If you have any more feedback or find any pesky bugs, join our Discord so we can get it sorted out!
https://discord.gg/jqnKH3wDj4

Stay tuned for more! 🐕
